forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {触|さわ}っていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To bring one's hand or body into contact with something. The object touched is marked with に.

examples.japanese: {触|さわ}らないで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.notes: Common sign in museums and stores

examples.japanese: ⟦ペンキ→ペンキ：00342_penki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{触|さわ}らないで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{触|さわ}る⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちいい→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧です。
examples.english: This fabric feels nice when you touch it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{触|さわ}ってもいいです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{触|さわ}らないで。
examples.english: It's hot, so don't touch it.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive - takes に). No pair verb. Pattern: X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{触|さわ}る (touch X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing/repeated action. {触|さわ}っている = 'is touching.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・X⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{触|さわ}る (touch X)
・{触|さわ}らないで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ (please don't touch)
・{触|さわ}る⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ (you can tell by touching)
・⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{触|さわ}る (touch with hand)

Note: Uses に (not を) for the thing being touched.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧ is more formal and literary. It also covers brief or accidental contact and, figuratively, touching on a topic (⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{触|ふ}れる = to touch on an issue). {触|さわ}る is everyday speech and almost always means deliberate physical contact.
・{触|さわ}る often carries a nuance of handling something one perhaps should not, which is why it is the verb used on 'do not touch' signs.
